hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning, Repair and Installation in Evanston, IL
hero.sub: A driveway that floods, a backyard basin packed with leaves or an old brick basin falling apart. We clean, rebuild, replace and install catch basins, and clear the lines behind them. Our Evanston office is on Orrington Avenue, downtown.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: A catch basin is a chamber under a grate that collects runoff from a yard, driveway, gangway or downspouts. Leaves and grit settle to the bottom, and the water flows out through a pipe. In many older Evanston yards, that pipe ties into the house sewer, so a neglected basin can affect your basement too.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.answer: At least once a year, usually after the leaves fall. Under big trees, twice a year helps.

items.q: Can you install a new catch basin?
items.answer: Yes. We install new basins in low spots and connect them to a proper drain line.

items.q: Should I repair or replace my old basin?
items.preview: It depends on the walls and outlet.
items.answer: If the walls are sound, a rebuild of the top and a new grate is often enough. If it's collapsing, replacement makes more sense.

items.q: Can a clogged basin flood my basement?
items.answer: Yes. Pooled water can seep in through walls and window wells, and a basin tied to the sewer can back up.

items.q: Do you clean commercial parking lot basins?
items.answer: We focus on homes. For large parking lots, a vacuum truck service is usually the better fit.

items.q: How much does catch basin work cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on the job. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it's a cleaning, repair, replacement or new install. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
